cmsFields.title: PostHog review: self-hosting and license boundaries
cmsFields.subtitle: Does repository access make self-hosting equivalent to the supported hosted product?
cmsFields.summary: PostHog repository review of product architecture, hobby self-hosting and mixed licensing, with deployment and privacy questions left explicit.
keyTakeaways: The pinned README distinguishes Cloud from unsupported hobby self-hosting.
The hobby configuration names multiple stateful dependencies, not one standalone analytics process.
MIT Expat root terms explicitly exclude the enterprise directory.
